description: ADACL - Réseau TERÉGA (ex-TIGF) sur le département des Landes (emprise des servitudes et canalisations abandonnées) is a dataset listed in Geocatalogue France, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by BUREAU DE RECHERCHES GÉOLOGIQUES ET MINIÈRES. TERÉGA network (ex-TIGF) on the department of Landes. Servitudes applying to gas transmission lines as well as the abandoned grid line. Coverage: FR. The portal shows the English title as "ADACL - TERÉGA network (ex-TIGF) on the department of Landes (right-of-way of easements and abandoned pipes)" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include Réseau Gaz, Réseaux de transport, Servitudes, TEREGA. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support water network and flood-defence studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-geocatalogue-fr.
